name: Master's Strange Side
source:
My name is Liber. I am a puppet who is brought to life by my Master. I like living a lot. Walking is very fun. I like staying with Master... But I wish I can go outside. Out the window, I see green grass and big trees. I would like to touch them, but Master won't let me. I am not allowed to leave our little home...

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/masters-strange-side]Itch.io[/url]]
